settings.title: Kids Chores
settings.resetHint: Clears today's check-offs for everyone and sets the reward webhook to no.
error.loadTitle: Kids Chores could not be loaded
hint.midnight: Chores reset after midnight in the time zone below, for everyone. The reward webhook changes from yes to no.
hint.local: Chores stay in this browser. The service beside Yuvomi is what makes the same account see them on a PC and an iPad.
hint.testNeedsService: The test needs the server service.
settings.webhookInfoIntro: Homey uses ?event= from the URL. The same JSON shape is sent when the goal is reached, and at midnight or Reset today.
settings.webhookInfoReached: When the daily point goal is reached:
settings.notifyAdmin: Record in points history when the goal is reached
settings.shareHint: On: chores are stored for the household. A generic chore shows for everyone. A chore linked to a child shows only for that child, and you follow the people you check below. Off: each member keeps a separate list. The same account still syncs across a PC and an iPad. Without a separate service, the list is kept in the note Kids Chores, which the whole household can read.
settings.shareOff: Sync across users is off. This list belongs to the signed-in account.
settings.followHint: Check which children's chores you want to see, in addition to the generic ones.
chores.title: Chores
chores.field.unlockDelayHint: 0 = no delay. With “wait until chores above”: counted from when the last chore above was finished. Without: from midnight in the household time zone.
chores.field.requireUnlock: Wait for a webhook before the chore is visible
chores.unlockHint: Turn on webhook unlock and save to get a token and example payload Homey can POST.
chores.unlockInfoIntro: Homey (Logic → Call webhook / Make web request) posts to Yuvomi. Same JSON shape as the reward webhook.
chores.field.title: Title
chores.field.requireAbove: Wait until the chores above are done
chores.forHint: No check: the chore is generic. Check a child to link it only to that child. Everyone links it to each child, and you can clear the ones who should not have it.
chores.membersMissing: The member list could not be loaded. Who has this chore stays as it is.
reasons.unreachable: Kids Chores could not be reached.
reasons.internal: Something went wrong in Kids Chores.
reasons.auth: Sign in to use Kids Chores.
reasons.forbidden: You do not have permission for that.
reasons.csrf: The page was out of date. Try again.
reasons.origin: The request came from an unexpected site.
reasons.day: That chore is not scheduled today.
reasons.limit: A household can have at most 48 chores.
reasons.webhook: The webhook URL could not be used.
reasons.webhook_denied: The webhook did not allow this.
reasons.locked: Finish the chores above this one first.
reasons.upstream: The household session could not be checked.
reasons.notes: Kids Chores could not read or save the household note.
reasons.too_large: The chore list is too big to share in a note. Shorten the webhook addresses or remove chores.
